## [EXP-001027: critical graph seminorm onsite-stability obstruction] - 2026-08-24

EXP-001027 records a scoped QFT-side route obstruction for the canonical two-sided K^(-1/2)-damped graph commutator seminorm. The exact Weyl identities give L_K(W_a) <= 2a, while the imported critical-half lower bound at t_a=tau/a^2 gives G tau a - B_tau. With the manifest fixture G=51/35, tau=2, B_tau=3/2 and C=1, the lower-minus-proposed-upper difference is (32/35)a - 3/2 - 4/a, equal to 507/70 at a=10 and positive for all sufficiently large a. Primary and independent lanes pass 19/19, the integrated lane passes 21/21, and Lean R211 passes scalar arithmetic. This removes only the declared seminorm; it does not reject all non-Leibniz topologies, prove Q3 dynamics, or close common alpha, KMS, gap, Pre-A, Sector A, TECT production or Clay gates. The next route is a frequency-profiled analytic/Frechet or state-weighted topology, with projected-Duhamel and local-strict histories retained.

## [EXP-001028: conditional first-passage Poisson boundary bridge] - 2026-08-24

EXP-001028 records a conditional first-passage Poisson bridge for the Q3 boundary-response gate. Under an explicit nonnegative factorial Duhamel expansion, a degree bound z, finite source support and path distance d, the spatial weight base^d yields R_x(t) <= base^(-d) exp(eta z t base) R_X(0). The fixture z=6, eta=1, t=1/3, base=2, d=10 gives weighted rate 4 and envelope exp(4)/2^10 < 0.1. Primary passes 20/20, independent 19/19, integrated 25/25, and Lean R212 passes. The actual Q3 expansion, two-orientation operator response, volume-uniform path coefficient, exhaustion Cauchy and common alpha remain open; no TECT heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.
